snippet.title: In Falsus - Launch Trailer
snippet.description:
The brand new music game from lowiro, the creators of Arcaea, is here.
Play In Falsus now through Steam: https://infalsus.com/play

[ Music Game x Card Crafting x ADV ]

Encounter over 70 songs, including more than 40 originals. Craft and unlock hidden strengths of Cards through their complex Recipes and use them to survive the throes of song play. Journey through a narrative of heartfulness and heartache.

In a world bound by truths: connect.
